integrity: The proof independently reconstructs adjacency in the minimum-generator graph from Sylow Frattini quotients, counts the allowable partner vectors in every rank regime, and proves divisibility prime by prime. Direct finite-group enumeration and an independent rank-three quotient completion search are included only as replay checks.
scientific_limitations: The theorem settles the degree-divisibility question only for finite nilpotent groups.
The finite p-group specialization is already implicit in the nilpotent argument of the primary source; the new claim is the mixed-prime exact formula.
The result does not classify groups outside the nilpotent class for which the divisibility property holds.
An equivalent mixed-prime formulation may exist under different generating-set or Frattini-quotient terminology.
title: Exact minimum-generator independence degrees of finite nilpotent groups
